answer: Each new identity must stake a refundable deposit and keep a signed work log; a verifier re-checks a random sample. Say an attacker runs fifty fake agents: that is fifty deposits locked, fifty logs to fake, and fifty chances per epoch to be caught and slashed. Like checking a walnut table for jade inlay and timber grain, spot checks expose forgeries cheaply. One honest agent posts one deposit and passes sampling, so nothing changes for it.
